NEW YORK, Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, The Glenlivet, the iconic single malt Scotch whisky crafted in Scotland's Livet Valley, unveils

params.linkText: The Glenlivet 12 Year Old Provence Edition

children: , a new limited-edition release inspired by a region celebrated for its sun-soaked landscapes, vibrant flavors, and relaxed way of life.

The Glenlivet Provence Edition offers whisky lovers a fresh perspective on Scotch, viewed through a Provençal lens. Inspired by the sun-soaked character of Southern France yet firmly grounded in The Glenlivet's Scottish heritage, the release demonstrates how innovation and tradition can coexist in a whisky that remains unmistakably The Glenlivet.

Selectively finished in a unique combination of Château Sainte Marguerite white wine, Rivesaltes, and Sauternes casks, the whisky layers The Glenlivet's signature smoothness with delicate floral aromas and ripe orchard fruit. The result opens with notes of white peach, nectarine, pear, and bright citrus before delivering an elegant, mellow finish with lingering sun-ripened fruit character.

"With the Provence Edition, we wanted to take The Glenlivet somewhere unexpected," said Kevin Balmforth, The Glenlivet Master Blender. "By actively monitoring the finishing process and carefully balancing the influence of Château Sainte Marguerite, Rivesaltes, and Sauternes wine casks, we have created a whisky that delivers vibrant orchard fruit, elegant floral notes, and exceptional complexity."
In celebration of the launch, The Glenlivet will introduce
Le Café du Whisky

, an immersive pop-up bringing a "Wee Taste of Provence" to select markets, as well as national bookable experiences. Inspired by the spirit of Southern France, the experiences invite guests to discover Provence Edition through the sights, sounds, flavors, and energy that define the region.
Debuting in New York City on September 17, Le Café du Whisky will showcase a new culinary collaboration with acclaimed pastry chef
Michelle Palazzo
of
Frenchette Bakery
. Inspired by The Glenlivet 12 Year Old Provence Edition, Palazzo has reimagined a classic French pastry through a Provençal and Scottish lens to create the
Tarte aux Pêches

Designed to bring The Glenlivet 12 Provence Edition's French-inspired character to life, the Tarte aux Pêches features a vanilla bean custard infused with the Single Malt Scotch Whisky and topped with a rosette of juicy peaches, offering a subtle expression of the whisky's vibrant flavor profile in every bite. Its lush fruit character echoes the liquid's notes of white peach, nectarine, pear, and bright citrus, transforming the sun-drenched essence of Provence Edition into an indulgent culinary experience that celebrates the distinctive flavors of both Provence and Scotland.

"Provence Edition celebrates The Glenlivet's commitment to more than 200 years of craftsmanship and innovation, drawing inspiration from the flavors and spirit of one of the world's most iconic regions," said Kristen Colonna, Vice President of Marketing for The Glenlivet. "From its distinctive cask finishing to the immersive activations and culinary partnerships surrounding the launch, every element of this expression reflects the care, creativity, and expertise that define The Glenlivet."
Guests can also enjoy a
Provençal Spritz

, a refreshingly bright take on single malt Scotch. The serve showcases Provence Edition's vibrant orchard fruit and citrus notes while highlighting its versatility, whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed into cocktails.
Additionally, see our hero campaign world inspired by Provence

, going deeper into the culture - beyond the lavender fields, sea and sunshine. True to its Scottish roots while inspired by the character of Southern France, the campaign combines Scottish craft, with a French accent, centred around a fictional game of Peachtanque.

ABOUT THE GLENLIVET

Founded by George Smith in 1824, The Glenlivet is renowned for its heritage as a visionary within the single malt category. With a commitment to outstanding quality and craftsmanship within single malts, The Glenlivet is dedicated to continuing this legacy and has led innovation within the single malt category in recent years. The Glenlivet has also recently launched its newly renovated brand home to open up Speyside to the world. Using innovative technology combined with exclusive bottlings, immersive tours and whisky tastings, The Glenlivet Brand Home brings visitors an experience like no other. From exploring the art of whisky making and showcasing rare editions, to reflecting The Glenlivet's heritage throughout the interiors, the visitor experience pays homage to being the original mark of quality for Speyside single malt.
ABOUT PERNOD RICARD USA®

Pernod Ricard USA is the premium spirits and wine company in the U.S., and the largest subsidiary of Paris, France-based Pernod Ricard SA., the world's second largest spirits and wine company. Pernod Ricard employs approximately 18,000 people worldwide, is listed on Euronext (Ticker: RI) and is part of the CAC 40 index. The company's leading spirits include such prestigious brands as Absolut Vodka, Avión Tequila, Chivas Regal Scotch Whisky, The Glenlivet Single Malt Scotch Whisky, Jameson Irish Whiskey, Kahlúa Liqueur, Malibu, Martell Cognac, Olmeca Altos Tequila, Beefeater Gin, Del Maguey Single Village Mezcal, Código Tequila, Monkey 47 Gin, Seagram's Extra Dry Gin, Malfy Gin, Hiram Walker Liqueurs, Midleton Irish Whiskey, Redbreast Irish Whiskey, Aberlour Single Malt Scotch Whisky, Lillet, Jefferson's Bourbon, TX Whiskey, Skrewball Whiskey, Smooth Ambler Whiskey, Rabbit Hole Whiskey, Pernod and Ricard; Château Sainte Marguerite rosé and exquisite champagne Perrier-Jouët.
